# Verma Khad Bhandar

> Verma Khad Bhandar (वर्मा खाद भंडार) is an authentic agricultural supplies shop providing verified fertilizers, certified crop seeds, crop protection pesticides, and essential plant nutrition to farmers across Rasra, Kurem, Dulahpah, and surrounding agricultural areas in Ballia, Uttar Pradesh.

## Business Information

- **Legal / Trading Name**: Verma Khad Bhandar
- **Hindi Name**: वर्मा खाद भंडार
- **Business Type**: Agricultural Supplies Retailer / Fertilizer & Seed Shop (LocalBusiness / Store)
- **Primary Service Area**: Rasra, Kurem, Dulahpah, Badhubandh Market, Chilkahar, Kasimabad, Ballia District (Uttar Pradesh)
- **Tagline**: हर खेत की तरक्की, हमारी जिम्मेदारी (Growing Better Crops. Building a Better Tomorrow.)

## Location and Contact

- **Physical Address**: Rasra Kasimabad Road, Badhubandh Market, Rasra, Dulahpah, Uttar Pradesh 221712, India
- **Hindi Address**: रसड़ा कासिमाबाद रोड, बाधुबांध मार्केट, रसड़ा, दुलहपाह, उत्तर प्रदेश 221712

## Product Categories

1. **खाद एवं उर्वरक (Fertilizers & Nutrients)**:
   - Nitrogenous fertilizers (Urea)
   - Phosphatic fertilizers (DAP - Di-Ammonium Phosphate)
   - Complex fertilizers (NPK 12:32:16, 20:20:0:13)
   - Potassic fertilizers (MOP - Muriate of Potash)
   - Secondary & micronutrients (Zinc Sulphate 33% & 21%, Sulphur, Boron)
   - Organic manure and bio-fertilizers

2. **उन्नत बीज (Certified Quality Seeds)**:
   - Certified high-yield wheat seeds (Rabi season varieties suited for eastern UP soils)
   - High-germination paddy / rice seeds (Kharif season)
   - Mustard seeds (Rabi oilseeds)
   - Potato seed tubers
   - Maize, pulses (chickpea, green peas, moong, urad)
   - Hybrid and open-pollinated seasonal vegetable seeds

3. **कीटनाशक एवं फसल सुरक्षा (Crop Protection & Pesticides)**:
   - Target insecticides for sucking pests, borer larvae, and crop worms
   - Agricultural fungicides for blast, blight, rust, and fungal wilt control
   - Selective herbicides and weedicides for wheat and paddy weed control

4. **पौध पोषक एवं टॉनिक (Plant Growth Promoters & Tonics)**:
   - Foliar micro-nutrient sprays
   - Seaweed extract & bio-stimulants
   - Plant growth regulators (PGRs) for root development, tillering, and flowering

## Agricultural Information

- **Regional Soil**: Alluvial Gangetic plain soil of Ballia/Rasra requiring balanced NPK ratio (4:2:1) supplemented with Zinc and organic matter.
- **Rabi Crop Calendar**: October to April (Wheat sowing November–December, Mustard October–November, Potato October).
- **Kharif Crop Calendar**: June to November (Paddy nursery June, transplantation July, harvest October–November).
- **Zaid Crop Calendar**: March to June (Moong, Urad, seasonal cucurbits, and vegetables).

## Languages

- **Primary**: Hindi (हिन्दी) — Complete bilingual localization for farming community.
- **Secondary**: English — Full support with instant toggle.
